DIAMETER_EGRESS
Description
An
iRule event
triggered when the system is ready to
send a DIAMETER message. The context of this event shifts based on
where the message originated.
If the client sent the message, DIAMETER_EGRESS is a serverside event
If the server sent the message, DIAMETER_EGRESS is a clientside event
Note: this event does not apply
to
CER/CEA
messages
until 11.3.0-HF3 (and above). If handling these messages is required
in earlier versions then you’ll need to perform a binary scan to
modify AVPs.
Examples
when
DIAMETER_EGRESS
{
if
{[
serverside
]}
{
if
{
[
DIAMETER
::
command
]
==
"257"
}
{
log
local0.
"CER sent from [IP::local_addr] to [IP::remote_addr] with origin-host [DIAMETER::host origin]"
}
}
}
Related Information
Available Commands:
DIAMETER::message
- returns the whole
Diameter message as a TCL string object.
